_note: GST rule pack (I5): versioned, sourced data the engine selects by document date. Stage 1 ships the entries the prototype needs, all marked unverified; Stage 3 verifies every line against the official source (at most 3 may stay unverified). Never edit an entry after it is verified: add one with a new effectiveFrom.

entries.source: https://www.cbic.gov.in/ — 56th GST Council (3 Sep 2025) rate rationalisation, notifications effective 22 Sep 2025

entries.rule: Supplier and place of supply in the same State or UT: CGST + SGST/UTGST, each at half the rate. Different States: IGST at the full rate.

entries.source: https://cbic-gst.gov.in/CGST-rules.html (CGST Rules 2017, rules 46 and 49: tax invoice, bill of supply)
entries.verifiedBy: build agent, against the text of CGST Rules 2017 r. 46 (tax invoice) and r. 49 (bill of supply); the operator re-confirms in Stage 3
